data.narrative:
Poolside is a Series B AI & Software company founded by Jason Warner and Eiso Kant, having raised $626M+ to date. The valuation assessment draws on a peer universe of nine private companies and one public comparable (Palantir), spanning robotics, foundation models, and infrastructure software at Series A through Series C stages. Key peers include Figure AI ($39.0B, Series C), Reflection AI ($25.0B, Series A), Skild AI ($14.0B, Series C), Crusoe Energy ($10.0B, Series C), and Together AI ($8.3B, Series A).

Two valuation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis, using total capital raised as a proxy for current value, applies a 1.9x step-up multiplier typical for Series B advancement, yielding $1.2B. Peer-median analysis across seven same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables produces a $10.0B implied valuation, with the peer set ranging from $3.2B to $39.0B. This wide dispersion reflects heterogeneity in business model maturity and capital efficiency within early-stage AI.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $1.0B (low) to $11.5B (high), with a median of $5.6B. The gap between stage-progression and peer-median methods reflects uncertainty around capital efficiency relative to peers and the maturity of Poolside's underlying technology and go-to-market. Key sensitivities include revenue traction, gross margin profile, and competitive positioning within the narrower AI infrastructure subset.
